description.p: GitGrove is a fast desktop Git client built on the system Git binary. It manages repositories, branches, worktrees, tags, releases and pipelines, and supports multiple Git identities for commits and pushes.

ul.li: Commit graph with staging, commit, amend and sign-off
Pull requests, releases and CI pipelines for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Gitea
Per-repository identity and per-forge account mapping
Built-in git console that runs git directly, without a shell

screenshot.caption: Commit graph with staging and repository details

description.p: First public preview: repositories, branches, worktrees, tags, stashes, releases, pipelines and multi-account identities.
